Built in Jubail.
Trusted Across the Kingdom.
Luxury Wooden Works is Our Professional Identity.
Established in 2004, ARFAD operates in architectural wood works, interior furnishing and wooden furniture manufacturing from Jubail Industrial City.

Specializing in Wooden Doors, Kitchen Cabinets, Wardrobes, Cladding, Ceilings, Wooden Floorings, Timber & WPC Decking, Countertops, Vanities, all types of Joineries and Custom Interior and Exterior Solutions. ARFAD serves residential, hospitality, government, industrial, and mega-project sectors across the Kingdom.
A regional standard in architectural wood works.
High-quality wood works that deliver long-term value.
A system built for demanding projects.

items.text: A 20,000 m² facility in Jubail Industrial City, with dedicated production zones from raw material storage to quality control.

ARFAD Wood Factory is equipped with a comprehensive range of specialized woodworking machinery, supporting precision cutting, routing, shaping, sanding, pressing, edge banding, veneering, and CNC machining at industrial scale.
Engineers and draftsmen working in direct coordination with production and project teams.

From drawing to delivery, in six controlled stages.
Registered with the Kingdom's leading clients and authorities.

items.text: Responsible Wood Sourcing. Certified Chain of Custody.

ARFAD is FSC Chain of Custody certified, demonstrating its commitment to responsible wood sourcing and the traceability of certified wood products throughout the supply chain. This certification enables ARFAD to support projects with sustainability and responsible sourcing requirements.
Forest Stewardship Council of UK approved ARFAD as a FSC-STD-40-004 V3-1 Chain of Custody Certification, FSC-STD-50-001 V2-1 Requirements and meeting the Standards for use of the FSC trademarks.

items.text: Making a Positive Impact on the Environment.

items.group: Making a Positive Impact on the Environment.
items.text: Sustainability is our strategic approach to building a legacy for future generations, we understand the profound impact that the Woodwork industry can have on our natural resources and the environment. As a result, we prioritize integrating sustainable practices into all facets of our operations, ensuring that our activities, policies, and procedures align with environmentally responsible principles.
We use only environmentally friendly and sustainable materials in our projects to reduce our environmental impact while creating long-lasting and durable structures.
Our team utilizes the latest technology and innovative digital solutions to deliver efficient and cost-effective projects while minimizing our environmental footprint.

We maximize the utilization of resources to reduce waste and promote sustainability. Our team is trained to be resourceful and efficient, ensuring that every material and resource is used to its fullest potential.
